scope: Free ordinary admitted Pickup variants10/20/30/40 use common physical full motion, fast presentation prediction, authored ground collision and Bomb blast impulse. Live acceptance is pending; the retained Troll cohort's shared-seed, grid18, tinted-Rock and return differences remain required.

full.order: Advance ANM2 once, multiply physical velocity by entering current friction, add it to physical position, restore configured XML friction, resolve ground collision, then set the next current friction to configured friction*.965.
full.collision: Ground class5 uses authored collision radius/scale and entities2.xml numGridCollisionPoints. The supported ordinary families have radius12, mass3, friction1 and24 ordered collision samples. Static Collect504d30 clears velocity, writes grid class3 and entity class0, starts Collect, then sets dead31f; actual ordinary BombPU collection boundaries retain grid class5. The caller/reset responsible for that class discrepancy is unresolved and remains a required live failure.

fast.position: physicalPosition + (velocity * currentFriction) * .5, followed by fast ground correction; prediction does not mutate physical position or velocity and does not advance ANM2/age.
fast.restoration: Native backs up full physical position and restores it before the next full update. The port retains physical and presented fields separately.

blast.guards: Alive, nonzero entity collision class, grid class other than4, positive authored mass and strict distance<75+collisionRadius; zero-distance leaves velocity unchanged. This leaf dispatches only admitted ordinary families with mass3.
blast.rounding: 612790 rounds component squares and their sum before sqrt;612b30 divides each f32 component directly before612a70 multiplies impulse. It does not use Normalize612820's rounded reciprocal multiply.
blast.otherCallbacks: Ordinary pickup HP0 rejects the later damage virtual. This callback samples no RNG and requests no SFX.
